what: Plain-English explainer for every sleeve, keyed by lane id. Read by the GrokBot Desk terminal.

glossary.Fear day: A day when QQQ (the Nasdaq-100 fund) trades below its prior close. Most sleeves only buy on fear days, and only if the stock is down too.
glossary.Cyan signal: The UT-Bot trend indicator flips to buy while the engine's trend votes agree.
glossary.Green signal: The 8-period average crosses above the 21-period average while the engine's trend votes agree.
glossary.Swing signal: Most of the engine's 7 trend and momentum votes turn bullish at once.
glossary.Signal engine: The desk's signal engine. It computes 7 trend and momentum votes per stock and the Cyan, Green and Swing signals.
glossary.Sleeve: One strategy with its own rules and budget. Each desk runs many sleeves side by side.
glossary.Tier A: A signal that passes every research veto and has at least two independent supporting signals.
glossary.Time exit: The position is sold after a fixed number of trading days, weeks or bars, whatever the price.

1h.name: 1H Swing
1h.summary: Hourly swing trades on a fixed watch list, bought only while QQQ and the stock are both down on the day.
1h.looks_for: On a closed hourly bar, a Swing buy signal (at least 5 of the engine's 7 trend and momentum votes are bullish and bulls beat bears by 4 or more, confirmed by an early 'monitor' buy on that bar or one of the 3 before it) from the signal engine. The stock must be on the desk's frozen hourly swing watch list or match an active researched hourly setup.
1h.entry: Within 30 minutes after the signal bar, it buys only while QQQ and the stock are both below their prior daily close (otherwise it keeps checking until the 30 minutes run out). It sends one limit order, good for that day only: the current price plus 1%, never above 3% over the signal-day close.
1h.exit: Each signal carries its own exit plan: a time exit and, for some signals, a protective stop. For watch-list names that plan is no stop loss and a time exit after 60 hourly bars (about 9 trading days). There is no profit target, partial sale or trailing stop. The hold is counted from the signal bar. Every sale is one limit sell order at the price minus 1%; a time exit is sent about 20 minutes before its exit time.
1h.sizing: About $1,725 per stock, in whole shares, and never more than 1% of the stock's average daily dollar volume. Up to 30 positions at once, within a $51,750 sleeve budget. Every buy also needs free cash in the account.
1h.why: This sleeve trades the pattern above live, with fixed rules and a fixed budget.
1h.source: the signal engine via the desk's signal tracker

1d.name: 1D Green
1d.summary: Daily Green trend signals, bought on the next fear day and held up to 40 trading days.
1d.looks_for: At the daily close, a Green buy signal (the 8-period average crosses above the 21-period average while at least 6 of the engine's 7 trend and momentum votes agree) from the signal engine, on a name from the daily watch list or matching a researched daily setup.
1d.entry: It buys on the first of the 5 trading days after the signal when, between 40 and 10 minutes before the close, QQQ is below yesterday's close, the stock is at or below its own yesterday's close, and the price is no more than 2% above the signal-day close. It sends one limit order, good for that day only: the current price plus 1%, never above that 2% cap. If no such day comes, the signal is dropped.
1d.exit: Time exit after 40 trading days. Profit taking follows each signal's research plan: some sell everything at +20%; others sell a third at +30%, then sell the rest if the price falls back to the entry or 2 average daily ranges below its highest price since the buy. Positions carried over from the earlier desk also sell if the price falls 15% below the entry. The hold is counted from the fill. Every sale is one limit sell order at the price minus 1%; a time exit is sent about 20 minutes before its exit time.
1d.sizing: About $1,725 per stock, in whole shares, and never more than 1% of the stock's average daily dollar volume. Up to 6 positions at once, within a $10,350 sleeve budget. Every buy also needs free cash in the account.
1d.why: Buying only on red days for both the market and the stock avoids chasing a stock that has already jumped.
1d.source: the signal engine via the desk's signal tracker
